name: Helen M. McKeldin (Souder)
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Sister of Charles "Buckey" McKeldin, named in his daughter Barbara's memoir; died before she wrote. One of the aunts who called Barbara "Babs". [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 392, 4153]
Helen M. McKeldin Souder (1912–1994) on Find a Grave; aged 7 in the 1920 census and 17 in 1930.
